about: Small bundled list of well known weak versions. Each row: below = first fixed version. An online lookup (OSV) can be added later in server/safety-check.js through osvFetch; it is off by default.

advisories.name: undici
advisories.title: undici can be stalled by a crafted reply (DoS)
advisories.tldr: A web request library in your project can loop forever on a crafted Set-Cookie reply, which freezes the program. Update undici to 8.10.2 or newer.

advisories.name: lodash
advisories.title: lodash old version (prototype pollution, command injection)
advisories.tldr: An old lodash lets crafted input change how your program behaves. Update lodash to 4.17.21 or newer.

advisories.name: minimist
advisories.title: minimist old version (prototype pollution)
advisories.tldr: An old minimist can be tricked by crafted input. Update minimist to 1.2.6 or newer.

advisories.name: node-fetch
advisories.title: node-fetch old version (leaks private headers on redirect)
advisories.tldr: An old node-fetch can send private headers to another site on a redirect. Update node-fetch to 2.6.7 or newer.

advisories.name: axios
advisories.title: axios old version (may leak a security token)
advisories.tldr: An old axios can send a private token to the wrong place. Update axios to 1.6.0 or newer.

advisories.name: express
advisories.title: express old version (open redirect)
advisories.tldr: An old express can be tricked into sending visitors to another site. Update express to 4.19.2 or newer.

advisories.name: jsonwebtoken
advisories.title: jsonwebtoken old version (weak sign-in token checks)
advisories.tldr: An old jsonwebtoken can accept sign-in tokens it should refuse. Update jsonwebtoken to 9.0.0 or newer.

advisories.name: ejs
advisories.title: ejs old version (can run attacker code)
advisories.tldr: An old ejs can be made to run code from crafted input. Update ejs to 3.1.7 or newer.

advisories.name: requests
advisories.title: requests old version (leaks proxy login)
advisories.tldr: An old requests can leak a proxy login to the wrong site. Update requests to 2.31.0 or newer.

advisories.name: pyyaml
advisories.title: PyYAML old version (can run attacker code)
advisories.tldr: An old PyYAML can run code from a crafted file. Update PyYAML to 5.4 or newer.
